headline: UK Interest Rate Outlook Remains Focused on Potential Final Hike
summary: Economic analysis suggests that the Bank of England may implement one additional interest rate increase before concluding its current tightening cycle.
why: Interest rate decisions by central banks are the primary tool for managing inflation and economic growth, directly influencing borrowing costs and currency valuations.

impacts.name: Bank of England base rate
impacts.why: The report anticipates a final interest rate hike by the central bank.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Expectations of further interest rate hikes typically increase yields on government bonds and can strengthen the national currency as investors seek higher returns.
